findings.title: Light-theme heading color changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The `.topic-map h3` rule previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), ...)`, so the primary branch (the color used on light themes) is now 50% instead of 20%. The PR is meant to add a dark-theme branch, but this silently changes the light-theme heading color as well. The secondary branch also differs from the 80% used elsewhere for the same role. Keep the primary value at 20%.

findings.title: Group member name color lightness changed from 30% to 50% on light themes
findings.body: `.user-stream .group-member-info .name` used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement uses 50% for the primary branch, so light-theme names are rendered noticeably lighter. This is an unintended visual change beyond adding the dark-theme branch. Keep 30% for the primary branch.

findings.title: Mobile group member name color lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: Same problem as the desktop counterpart: `.group-member-info .name` previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The primary branch now uses 50%, which changes the light-theme appearance without any stated reason. Keep the original 30% for the primary branch.

findings.title: Custom message length color flipped from 70% to 30% lightness on light themes
findings.body: `.custom-message-length` previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, a pale grey. The new primary branch uses 30%, which is much darker. On the light theme this makes the counter text dark and highly visible, a large unintended change. The desktop version of this rule (desktop/modal.scss) keeps 70%, so the two are now inconsistent. Restore 70% for the primary branch.

findings.title: Topic map link color changed from 30% to 70% lightness on light themes
findings.body: `.topic-map .information`/`h5 a` link color previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The replacement uses 70% for the primary branch, which makes the link pale on light backgrounds and drastically reduces contrast. This is not a dark-theme fix; the primary value should stay at 30%.

findings.title: Comment describes the old single-color default for topic list cells
findings.body: The comment says the default for table cells in the topic list is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`. That is now a `dark-light-choose(...)` expression in many places, so the comment is stale and misleading for future maintainers.

findings.title: Pull request has no description or verification of the visual change
findings.body: The PR description is only 'Test 7' and gives no rationale, list of affected themes, or screenshots. Over 30 stylesheet files are touched, and several of the replacements change light-theme values (see the other findings). Nothing in the PR shows that the dark and light renderings were checked, so a reviewer cannot confirm the intended outcome.
